emergencyWarningText: ⚠️ WARNING: Only use this function if you know what you are doing. It switches external devices (e.g. balcony power plants) automatically during grid failures. Incorrect configuration can damage connected devices. See README.md for details.
cloudInfoText: SigenMicro micro-inverters communicate with the Sigenergy cloud via WLAN only and are not part of the Modbus protocol. With this option the adapter reads their live values from the Sigenergy cloud using your mySigen account. Your credentials are sent only to the Sigenergy cloud; the password is stored encrypted.
Read SigenMicro micro-inverters via the: Read SigenMicro micro-inverters via the Sigenergy cloud
Official Sigen OpenAPI (recommended, at: Official Sigen OpenAPI (recommended, at most every 5 minutes)
cloudAppWarningText: ⚠️ The mySigen app interface is not officially documented. Sigenergy may change or block it at any time without notice. Use the official OpenAPI if you do not need faster updates.
cloudIntervalHelpText: Changing the interface sets 300 s (OpenAPI) or 60 s (app interface). Minimum 300 s for the OpenAPI (Sigenergy rate limit), 30 s for the app interface.
